product.title: Amsterdam Food Tour in Jordaan District With Secret Food Tours

description.text: Gain a rare perspective of Dutch cuisine on this food and culture tour through Amsterdam's Jordaan district. A guide shares neighborhood stories and leads into hidden gem eateries rather than tourist-trap menus. Tastings typically include poffertjes, fresh herring, apple cake, cheeses, and other Dutch treats between canal-side streets. The walking format keeps the outing food-first for visitors who want Jordaan kitchens instead of generic city sightseeing. Stops include Anne Frank Monument, The Jordaan.
